params.name: filter
params.description:
* to load all the files and folder under specific parent -> parent_id=uuid,
        * to load folder or files on the root level no need for query params,
        * to load the items in the trash bin which are on the root level  ?trashed=true

info.name: Create New Node[folder]  or a new file

items.docs:
Create new Node or file. Maximum file size: 100MB for regular uploads, 2GB when using chunking technique.

For files larger than 100MB, use the chunking technique:

1. Split the file into chunks (recommended: 15MB per chunk)
2. Upload each chunk to: POST /api/v2/{customer_id}/file_uploads/upload_chunk
   Required parameters (FormData):
   - data[attributes][file]: The chunk blob
   - data[attributes][file-id]: Unique file ID (format: customer_id.uuid.filename)
   - data[attributes][original-file

params.name: filter
params.description:
Selects ticket attachments by their file_attachment uuid (same contract as the ticket-attachments listing / delete endpoints). Example for two files in bulk:
          ?filter[uuid][][predicate]=in&filter[uuid][][value][]=sdfs83sd-...&filter[uuid][][value][]=kjlsf83-...

params.name: parent_id
params.description: Optional. UUID of the destination DMS folder. Omit to target the DMS root ("All Files"). Must be a folder when present — file / virtual_component destinations are rejected.

params.name: ticket_uuid
params.description: Optional. Scopes the source listing to a single ticket; otherwise selection is driven entirely by the uuid filter. Required when `field_id` is provided (422 otherwise).

params.name: field_id
params.description: Optional. Scopes the copy to a single form field (a CustomFields::AttachmentType field id, e.g. `tf…`). When set, only that field's attachments are copied and a `ticket_uuid` is required. When omitted, field (form-field) attachments are ignored entirely — only general ticket attachments are copied.

items.docs: Validate the selected ticket attachments before copying them into DMS. Surfaces scan / processed / file_data issues, the per-customer max-attachments limit (`copy_to_dms_max_limit`, default 10) and resolves the target folder (or DMS root when parent_id is omitted). When `field_id` is omitted, field (form-field) attachments are ignored — only general ticket attachments are eligible.
